title: Planning a pottery workshop
instructions: 原创模拟情境，非官方试题；这是独立分科短测，不是40题完整试卷。开始前不看正文、原音、词表或答案。先独立完成8题并保存原始答案，提交后再核对依据。难度是编写目标，尚未经真实考生标定。
transcript:
Coordinator: Thanks for helping with next month's pottery workshop, Ben. The original plan was to use the upstairs studio, but the lift will be serviced that week. We have booked the ground-floor dining room instead. We can move the tables, and everyone will be able to get in without using stairs.
Ben: Are we keeping the original date?
Coordinator: Yes, Saturday the fourteenth. The session starts at ten, but helpers should arrive at nine to protect the floor. Please bring old towels. Plastic sheets slide too easily on this surface.
Ben: How many people can attend?
Coordinator: The room can hold twenty, but the tutor wants a maximum of twelve beginners so that she can check everyone's technique. We have nine bookings so far. Do not advertise twenty places just because we have twenty chairs.
Ben: What will people make?
Coordinator: A small bowl. We considered mugs, but handles need more time than we have. The tutor will demonstrate first, and then people will work on their own pieces. They must wear closed shoes. We provide aprons.
Ben: Can they take the bowls home that day?
Coordinator: No. They need to dry and then go into the kiln at the tutor's workshop. Participants can collect them from the library two weeks later. If a bowl cracks during firing, the tutor will explain what happened, but we cannot promise a replacement.
Ben: What about payment?
Coordinator: The fee includes clay and firing. The café is closed, so tea is included too. We will ask people to bring lunch. If someone cancels at least three days before the session, we can return the fee. Later cancellations receive a refund only if another person takes the place.
Ben: I will put those details in the confirmation email.

questions.prompt: Why has the venue moved to the ground floor?
options: The lift will be out of use.
The upstairs studio has fewer tables.
The tutor wants to use a kiln in the dining room.
answers: The lift will be out of use.
questions.evidence: the lift will be serviced that week.
questions.explanation: 电梯维护使楼上不便，换到无需楼梯的地点。

questions.prompt: What should helpers bring to protect the floor? Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS.
questions.explanation: 塑料布容易滑，旧毛巾才是要求。

questions.prompt: What is the maximum number of participants?
questions.evidence: the tutor wants a maximum of twelve beginners
questions.explanation: 二十是房间容量、九是当前报名，教学上限十二。

questions.prompt: Why will participants make bowls rather than mugs?
options: Handles would require too much time.
Mugs cannot be made from the supplied clay.
answers: Handles would require too much time.
questions.evidence: handles need more time than we have.
questions.explanation: 时间不足以做杯把，未说杯子材料不适合。

questions.prompt: Participants must wear ____ shoes. Write ONE WORD.
questions.explanation: 围裙由主办方提供，但鞋应为包脚款。

questions.prompt: Where will finished pieces be collected?
options: At the dining room that afternoon
questions.evidence: Participants can collect them from the library two weeks later.
questions.explanation: 烧制在老师工坊，领取在图书馆，二者不同。

options: Clay and a replacement for every cracked bowl
questions.evidence: The fee includes clay and firing. The café is closed, so tea is included too.
questions.explanation: 包括泥、烧制和茶；午饭自备，不保证裂损替换。

questions.prompt: When can a late cancellation receive a refund?
options: Only when the dining room is full
When another participant takes the place
answers: When another participant takes the place
questions.evidence: Later cancellations receive a refund only if another person takes the place.
questions.explanation: 不足提前三天的取消，需要有人补位才退款。
